* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] may even follow a character moving across his site.
* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] may not follow a vehicle, even if there is a character inside.
* If [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] is aboard a vehicle, he may not disembark it to follow. The entire vehicle may not follow either.
* Total battle destiny +1 counts all characters in the battle (including [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]).
* If Dark did not successfully complete any battle destiny draws, there is no total battle destiny and so it is not possible for this Interrupt to add to total battle destiny.
